details.note: M0 SFT REJECTED. Evaluated on the frozen behavioral held-out set (3650 records): call_f1 collapsed from B0's 0.6191 to 0.0046 at step 400 and 0.0000 from step 1200, i.e. the model stops calling tools entirely. Parsing stays valid (1.000), so this is a decision collapse, not a formatting failure. Root cause is the training corpus, not the trainer: only 9 of 55719 trainable records (0.0162%) contain a <tool_call> in their supervised target, because the records that carry tool-call supervision were rejected by the canonical boundary. SFT as configured is harmful and is not promoted.

M1 DPO REJECTED. Evaluated on the frozen behavioral held-out set (3650 records): call_f1 fell from B0's 0.6191 to 0.1715 at step 100 and 0.0258 by step 300, with call recall collapsing 0.9722 -> 0.0965 -> 0.0131. Over-calling was eliminated (0.6425 -> 0.0034) and clarification and unsupported accuracy improved sharply (0.10 -> 0.92 and 0.013 -> 0.62), so the run worked as specified, but on the promotion metric it is a regression that degrades monotonically from the first measured checkpoint. The preference data is real, balanced and held-out-disjoint; the failure is the starting point. B0 recalls 97% of gold CALLs and 1.3% of UNSUPPORTEDs, so every signal that moves it off always-call reduces call recall.

Fails on DEV: over_call_rate. M0 SFT on finalized Canonical-v2 REJECTED. Evaluated on the pre-registered internal partitions: DEV (2373 records) for checkpoint selection, and the 1277-record confirmatory partition scored once for the selected checkpoint. The model is materially better behaved than both comparators -- on the confirmatory partition call_f1 0.7470 against B0's 0.6264 and the partial-v2 M0's 0.6278, with call recall recovered 0.5342 -> 0.7594 at precision 0.7350 (B0 0.4618) and over-call rate 0.1505 (B0 0.6238) -- so this is a rejection for a specific unmet constraint, not a failed run. It fails regression.call_recall: 0.7197 on DEV against B0's 0.9715 is a delta of -0.252, beyond the 0.10 allowance. That is the only failing check on the confirmatory partition, where every other check passes, and the verdict is identical whether the baseline is the frozen full-set B0 artifact or B0 rescored on the partition, so it does not depend on which baseline is used. The underlying cause is a structural tension rather than a defect: B0's 0.9715 recall is produced by calling a tool on 65% of examples whose gold answer is not a call, so the policy's over-call ceiling (0.20) and its recall floor cannot both be satisfied by a calibrated model. The gate was left unchanged rather than relaxed after seeing the result, and is recorded as a design finding for the next experiment. Checkpoint selection, by the rule frozen before the run, disqualified the two highest call_f1 checkpoints (1200: 0.7382, 600: 0.7191) for over-calling above the ceiling and selected 1800 by tie-break over 2400 (macro delta 0.0013, inside the 0.01 tolerance).
